snippet.title: Beatdown City Survivors Official Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Announcing Beatdown City Survivors, an immersive sandbox monster bashing bullet heaven game! Upgrade oddball weapons like pigeons, boots, & fireworks. Combine them to create hilarious game breaking strategies. Kick, burn, recruit survivors, craft combo weapons, freeze, crush, electrify--and survive!

Wishlist today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383040/Beatdown_City_Survivors/

Backing track is Up to Speed by SKECH185 & Jeff Markey, published by Backwoodz Studioz.

Stream / Buy it here - https://skech185.bandcamp.com/album/he-left-nothing-for-the-swim-back

https://backwoodzstudioz.com/
